_comment: Quarantined qa/results report dirs: readings the gate must NOT judge future runs against. A dir belongs here only when the tree that produced it was known-defective and never committed. Deleting such dirs would work too, but a list with a reason is auditable and this one is not; every entry names the run, the defect, and the D-entry. loadHistory() skips these when assembling the mode distribution.

excluded.reason: D635: measured the first D623 BarPulse attempt, which set the pulse mask/travel imperatively on a renderer-owned node. reconcile.js:99-103 stripped the style attribute on the next render, so the wave painted unmasked. pulse-phase-0.75 read 2175 (true value 1590) and pulse-phase-0.25/0.5 read a falsely STABLE 1590/1897 -- an unmasked wave paints a fixed shape. That build was never committed.
